EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows an NH stretch at 3368 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-002) and strong CH stretches at 2950/3014 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003), consistent with an unsaturated N-containing ring bearing NH and aliphatic substituents. A distinct carbonyl band appears at 1706 cm⁻¹, matching a conjugated C=O in a heterocycle. The intense doublet at 1220/1242 cm⁻¹ is characteristic of coupled C–N/C–O modes (amide III–like region), and the 1614 cm⁻¹ band fits C=C/C=N stretching in an enaminone-type ring. Out-of-plane/ring modes near 755–771 and 890–919 cm⁻¹ further support a nonaromatic unsaturated ring. Candidate 1 (CCC1=CC(=O)C(=N)N1) uniquely provides carbonyl, imine, and NH functionalities without a nitrile or phenolic OH, matching the observed bands better than other options (e.g., 2 lacks NH; 8 has a nitrile not observed).
